purpose: Archive the native high-order numerical output for the supplied Eq. (6) L00 benchmark at Delta m = 450 keV.

regression_tests.workflow_step: Run supplied L00 benchmark regression tests

artifact_transfer.note: The transfer ZIP is not committed; its extracted native JSON output is committed instead.

interpretation_and_limitations: The L00 value is an initial-spin-averaged and final-spin-summed Dirac trace.

The conditional chi2 width assumes Dirac chi1 and chi2, a pure scalar off-diagonal Yukawa vertex, chi2 -> chi1 s as the only open decay channel, and excludes the vector-sector self-energy contribution.
The pointwise L00 diagnostic uses the inherited target-rest-frame kinematics listed in the JSON output.
The reduced Eq. (6) integral and differential cross section divided by the nuclear response are not halo-folded event rates.
No nuclear response, halo integral, detector efficiency, energy resolution, exposure, or likelihood is included.
